t: Compounding Craft: Future-Proofing Your Tech Skills in the Age of AI
s: This article argues against rapid tech obsolescence by advocating for mastery of foundational, open-source tools (Linux, Python, Vim, Git, Nix) and employing a strategy of small, compounding wins to build enduring tech skills and craftsmanship, even in the age of AI.
sub: Combating tech churn with foundational, open-source skills.
Compounding small wins for skill mastery and career longevity.
Leveraging AI as a tool while maintaining personal agency in tech.
